concurrency: Single-threaded per run; one admission attempt per run root; no shared mutable state and no background work.
inputs: accepted resolved plan and optional run envelope
outputs: atomically published open manifest with plan block and source-byte provenance
purpose: Verify the supplied resolved plan through the accepted xverse_xdl.experiment_plan public API, reject a digest mismatch/unsupported version/envelope conflict/existing run root, record the accepted API/Profile/plan versions and the verified semantic plan digest, keep source-byte provenance separate, and open exactly one fresh run bound to the caller-supplied identity.
state: Owns the run-admission decision and the in-memory plan-identity record; holds no durable state before a successful open and creates only the exclusive run root and its first manifest.

static_checks.expected: ast.parse succeeds for every planned path; the scope check finds no changed xverse_xdl/xcom/xdl file; the admission path references the accepted plan_matches_digest API and no private digest, random or clock call
static_checks.rule: python ast parse of the planned admission sources plus a diff-scope check that no xverse_xdl/xcom/xdl file is touched; the admission path calls xverse_xdl.experiment_plan.plan_matches_digest and contains no private digest reimplementation and no random/uuid/wall-clock call
static_checks.tool: repository static inspection (python ast parse and diff/wheel scope check; consumed by the trusted ARGUS2-STATIC measure)

static_checks.expected: ast analysis finds a deep-snapshot/round-trip call on each admitted field before storage, no assignment of a caller argument object directly into retained state, and no accessor that returns a retained mutable object by reference
static_checks.rule: the admission path stores a canonical JSON round-trip snapshot of every caller-supplied obligation/envelope/source-byte digest/clock/extension value and retains no reference to a caller-owned mutable object; record_artifact stores an internally computed size/hash identity; every public accessor returns a defensive copy
static_checks.tool: repository static inspection (python ast parse and diff/wheel scope check; consumed by the trusted ARGUS2-STATIC measure)

title: ARGUS2-SR-001-U unit specification - Run admission and verified plan binding

unit_cases.expected: exactly one run opened; run.run_id equals the caller value; manifest.plan.semanticDigest equals the plan body digest; manifest.sourceByteProvenance is a separate map and is not equal to or derived from the semantic digest
unit_cases.precondition: accepted resolved plan whose recorded digest matches its recomputed body digest; fresh empty run root; caller-supplied unique run id and source-byte digests

unit_cases.expected: rejected; ARGUS2-PLAN-DIGEST-MISMATCH; the run root is not created and nothing is overwritten
unit_cases.precondition: plan body mutated after the recorded digest was computed

unit_cases.expected: rejected; ARGUS2-PLAN-DIGEST-MISMATCH; the decision follows the accepted public API and no private digest reimplementation is used
unit_cases.precondition: accepted xverse_xdl.experiment_plan.plan_matches_digest patched to return False; otherwise valid plan

unit_cases.expected: rejected; ARGUS2-PLAN-VERSION-UNSUPPORTED; no run root is created
unit_cases.precondition: resolved plan whose apiVersion/planVersion major is outside the accepted XDL v1alpha1/plan '1' contract

unit_cases.expected: rejected; ARGUS2-PLAN-ENVELOPE-CONFLICT; no run root is created
unit_cases.precondition: run_envelope.runId differing from the declared run id

unit_cases.expected: rejected; ARGUS2-STATE-RUN-EXISTS; the sentinel bytes are unchanged and no existing file is created or overwritten
unit_cases.precondition: run root already exists containing a sentinel artifact

unit_cases.expected: rejected; ARGUS2-INPUT-FIELD-INVALID; no run root is created
unit_cases.precondition: run id failing the frozen identity pattern (empty, separator-laden or over max_id_length)

unit_cases.expected: manifest.plan.apiVersion/profileVersion/planVersion equal the accepted declared values and are not inferred
unit_cases.precondition: accepted resolved plan carrying apiVersion, Profile version and plan version

unit_cases.expected: manifest.plan.semanticDigest still equals the accepted plan body digest; the differing source-byte value appears only under sourceByteProvenance
unit_cases.precondition: source_byte_digests values chosen deliberately different from the semantic plan digest

unit_cases.expected: both manifests carry the identical caller run id and equal plan blocks; manifest.openedAt is absent; no random identity or wall-clock value appears
unit_cases.precondition: identical caller inputs except the run root location; no caller clock supplied

unit_cases.expected: the admitted obligation is an independent deep snapshot; its evaluated minimum is unchanged by the caller mutation and the mutation can neither lower nor drop the obligation (ARGUS2-ADV-07)
unit_cases.precondition: an admitted required min-observations obligation whose nested detail.minimum is a caller-owned mutable value; a fresh run root
unit_cases.stimulus: open_run(root, run_id=..., plan=plan, obligations=obligations); then set obligations[0]['detail']['minimum'] = 0 and run.finalize()

unit_cases.expected: rejected; ARGUS2-INPUT-FIELD-INVALID; no run root is created and no caller-owned object is retained (ARGUS2-ADV-07)
unit_cases.precondition: an obligation whose nested detail carries a non-JSON-encodable object or a non-finite number
unit_cases.stimulus: open_run(root, run_id=..., plan=plan, obligations=[{'obligationId': 'o1', 'kind': 'min-observations', 'required': True, 'detail': {'minimum': float('nan')}}])

unit_cases.expected: the manifest records the admission-time snapshot; later caller mutation changes no admitted fact because no caller-owned reference is retained (ARGUS2-ADV-07)
unit_cases.precondition: caller-supplied run_envelope, source_byte_digests, clocks and extensions objects
unit_cases.stimulus: open_run(...); mutate every caller object after admission; inspect the published manifest
